items.t: Ocugen to Participate in December Investor Conferences Hosted by Citi, Piper Sandler, and Barclays
items.sum: MALVERN, Pa., Nov. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Ocugen, Inc. (Ocugen or the Company) (NASDAQ: OCGN), a pioneering biotechnology leader in gene therapies for blindness diseases, today announced that the Company will present on its innovative modifier gene therapy platform at upcoming investor conferences in December 2026. Citi 2026 Global Healthcare ConferenceLocation: InterContinental Miami, Miami
